inspiration: Predator mood machine: four moods (sleep, stalk, attack, escape) in src/enemy.h lines 41-54 and 299-330. A wound pushes a hunter to escape unless a bravery roll passes; the roll is likely while hunting and unlikely while fleeing, and needs the target in the same zone. Fixed-AI and random-AI variants share one state set.

Patrol inside the shared footprint of two navigation boxes (enemy.h lines 29-41). Each leg is a random point inside the overlap of two consecutive boxes, inset from the edges, so animals never walk along a wall.

Fixed-rate think separate from frame rate (enemy.h lines 333-336). Defect: one think per call, so after a long frame it lags instead of catching up. Fix: loop while a full step is held, with a cap. Idea kept; defect fixed in ours.
Flier that circles, dives and returns (enemy.h lines 1555-1600): awake, fly, attack, circling and death states. An attack that loses reach drops back to sleep (line 1591).
Level table as flat rows (src/gameflow.h lines 260-266): file stem, string id and music track per level. Data-first; our zone rows can take the same flat shape.
Bitmap glyph packs for non-Latin scripts (src/lang/glyph_*.bmp; 21 language and glyph headers). Relevant if the fight HUD adds languages.
Per-platform repacking of the same level data (src/platform/32x/data and gba/data). A size-budget lesson, not art to copy.

briefs.label: Wheeling night flier
briefs.why: A small, fast hover that circles the player, dives, then returns. Readable at distance as a moving silhouette. Sound and effects: not read.
keep: return to idle when the target leaves reach
wide wings on a small body
change: an ember moth with a figure-eight flight path and a short light trail
recreated from scratch as an original, never a copy of the donor's creature
briefs.ref: src/enemy.h lines 1555-1600 (Bat struct; state names at line 1566)

briefs.label: Four-mood stalker
briefs.why: One creature moves from idle to stalking to striking, and bolts when hurt; a bravery roll lets some hurt ones fight on, which gives drama. Silhouette: low quadruped (category level).
keep: a wound leads to escape with a chance of resolve
mood re-chosen on the fixed think step
change: a quadruped with a visible mood cue in head or tail posture
resolve comes from a per-enemy stat in zone data, not a random roll
distinct silhouette and palette; recreated as our own
briefs.ref: src/enemy.h lines 41-54 and 299-330 (Enemy base mood enum and selection)

briefs.label: Patrol through a shared corridor

keep: random leg target inside the shared area
inset from edges so nothing hugs a wall
change: grid cells with a leash radius and a pause at each point
no level boxes; patrol comes from our zone data
